label: Soft 3D
description: Rounded, toy-like 3D: soft materials, pastel colour, gentle global illumination. The warmth of a family animated film.
suits: children, cute explainers, how products and machines work, upbeat channels

motion: polished 3D character animation with appealing arcs, squash and stretch, springy secondary motion and a smooth camera
